source.name: IndoNLU EmoT
source.paper: IndoNLU: Benchmark and Resources for Evaluating Indonesian NLU

cross_domain_performance.note: Cross-domain accuracy of 1.0 was identified as an artifact of intersection-subset masking (shared-label masking artifact in score_100_pipeline.py). The EmoT dataset is retained solely for qualitative label vocabulary validation without quoting artificial 1.0 metrics.

interpretation: EmoT gold labels serve as external reference for the label schema validity across Indonesian NLP benchmarks, confirming theoretical grounding with Plutchik's emotion wheel on shared affective classes.
iaa_not_required: External benchmark (EmoT) is referenced for label schema comparability, while MBG model performance is evaluated strictly on the held-out holdout split.
